items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Had George Williams and some guys like that that happened to be in town at the time and we got some first-class swing music written up for the band

ctx.x: So, you put together the Hampton band here (inaudible) in Los Angeles?

Right. Yeah, he had a funny idea when he left Benny Goodman, that he was going to get a 17-piece band and have them playing all the tunes like they played with Benny Goodman's sextet, and that was his format on which he was basing having a big band, so we rehearsed for a couple of days and nothing was happening fast. So, I told him to have a seat and take it easy and we got two or three arrangers in town and they worked 24 hours a day and wrote a complete book inside of a week. Had George Williams and some guys…

That was the original "Flying Home" Band, with Illinois Jacquet (PHONETIC) and Dexter Gordon and that group of guys in the band and my brother was the high-note trumpet player in the band. That's how that band happened to get together. It was strictly by accident, because his format would have never worked and it didn't work, because he was going to have 16 people playing rhythm behind he and I. I was going to be his
